note: Re-judged 2026-10-18 (independent auditor, after a78870fd39). RFC 3768 Section 5.3.6 says "A packet with unknown authentication type or that does not match the locally configured authentication method MUST be discarded." TestDecodeGoldenV2 lost only the assertion on the removed MsgOnlyChecksum flag, which carried no RFC 3768 content, and TestNegativeReferenceBugs gained the FillChecksum mode argument and an rfc5798-compatible lookup in N1 alone; verifyReceived returns before any mode is read for version 2, so the VRRPv2 decode under judgement is unchanged. Auth Type 1, 2, 3, 128 and 255 are still each refused with ErrAuthType and Auth Type 0 accepted. Verdict unchanged.
